lines.en: I can walk without touching the ground
Half a block of altitude suits me
Paws hanging, too lazy to touch dust
I drift through the temple corridor

lines.zh: 走得快些，我的时间不多
lines.en: Walk faster, my time is short
One flick of my tail and the air parts
This floor does not deserve my feet
I hum a tuneless little song
A purple shadow slides along the wall
One pause, one drift, and I have arrived
I am not rushed, this place is just slow

lines.zh: 圆圆的耳朵听见了远处的动静
lines.en: My round ears catch a distant sound
This circle is purely a stroll

lines.zh: 我抬脚，地面没有留下印
lines.en: I step, and the ground keeps no print
This distance is not worth my effort

lines.zh: 飘着的我，比走着的你们快
lines.en: Floating, I outpace all of you walking
I yawn, and it lasts a while
My eyelids are nearly shut

lines.zh: 这地方太安静，容易犯困
lines.en: Too quiet here, it invites sleep
Arms folded, I hang in the air

lines.zh: 有人来之前，我再睡会儿
lines.en: I will nap until someone comes

lines.zh: 一百点的身体，也不经折腾
lines.en: A hundred points of body does not take much
I stretch out in this temple.

lines.zh: 当师父最麻烦的就是讲道理
lines.en: Being a master means explaining things

lines.zh: 我盯着天花板看了一会儿
lines.en: I stare at the ceiling a while
Nothing to do, so I rest

lines.zh: 空气里有一点熟悉的味道
lines.en: There is a familiar smell in the air

lines.zh: 我动了一下耳朵，又不动了
lines.en: My ears twitch once, then stop
You interrupted my nap
Say what you have to say, quickly

lines.zh: 你这点气，我一眼就看穿了
lines.en: I read your ki at a glance

lines.zh: 抬起手，让我看看你的架势
lines.en: Raise your hands, show me your stance

lines.zh: 我教的东西，你记不住就白学
lines.en: What I teach is wasted if you forget
Do not expect praise from me

lines.zh: 我一眼就知道你能走多远
lines.en: One look tells me how far you will go
Stand up straight, do not shrink

lines.zh: 你的问题比你的拳头多
lines.en: You have more questions than punches
I am sleepy, so keep it brief
You actually hit me
I only frown a little
This sting is like a mosquito bite
My eyes open a slit
My clothes are torn, how annoying
I drift back half a step and steady myself
You had better have a good reason
No one has touched me in a long time
I am not angry, only noting it

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就要认真了
lines.en: Once more and I will get serious
You bring me this little offering

lines.zh: 我挑得很，不合口味就别端
lines.en: I am picky, do not serve what I dislike
Set it down, let me smell it first

lines.zh: 你这份心意，我勉强收下
lines.en: I will take this gesture, barely

lines.zh: 当师父的，总有人送东西
lines.en: A master always gets gifts

lines.zh: 不合我意的话，你会知道
lines.en: If it displeases me, you will know

lines.zh: 多了吃不完，少了我生气
lines.en: Too much is waste, too little offends me
Arrange it neatly before you speak
My ears twitch and I sniff twice

lines.zh: 这算讨好我，还是试探我
lines.en: Is this flattery or a test
You touched my tail
I hover, and you still walk into me
Back off, I dislike being touched
A light wave of my hand makes wind enough

lines.zh: 你撞上来的样子很狼狈
lines.en: You look clumsy, running into me
This outfit wrinkles easily
You have less sense than a rock

lines.zh: 就差一点，你就惹恼我了
lines.en: A little more and you would annoy me

lines.zh: 我飘高了一点，你够不到
lines.en: I drift higher, out of your reach
Touching me comes at a price
After this long, I cannot be bothered

lines.zh: 能跟我并肩的，世上不多
lines.en: Few in this world could stand beside me
I need no one to fight for me

lines.zh: 同行的得受得住我的脾气
lines.en: A companion must bear my temper

lines.zh: 找个能说话的，比找能打的难
lines.en: Someone to talk to is rarer than someone to fight
I discuss it while yawning

lines.zh: 要同行，先学会不吵我睡觉
lines.en: To travel with me, learn not to wake me

lines.zh: 我这一路太长，有人也好
lines.en: My road is long, company would help
As long as we can watch the view together
I have no wish to carry dead weight
I pinch it between two claws
This is in the wrong place
Hovering makes bending awkward
I picked up what you dropped
Useless, but I am keeping it
I toss it and it sails away
Too dirty, I shake my hand
You cannot even hold your things
I look at it, then set it down
Even this small thing requires my hands
You actually mean to fight
Then I shall wake up a little

lines.zh: 眼睛睁开时，气氛就变了
lines.en: When my eyes open, the air changes
I raise one finger
You have courage, you lack judgment

lines.zh: 这一下，我只用一成的力
lines.en: I will use a tenth of my strength
Do not regret this, you started it
I dislike fighting, but I do not fear it
The ground where you stand grows hot
Then let us get some exercise
I watch you without being angry
I can count your strength exactly
One more step, try it

lines.zh: 破坏神的手指，抬起来了。
lines.en: The God of Destruction raises a finger.
I do not chase, you will come closer
The air warps at the edge of my palm
You are tense, I can smell it

lines.zh: 再看你一会儿，我就出手
lines.en: A moment more, and I strike
This fight is hardly fair to you
I already gave you a chance
One flick and you are airborne
A casual wave is enough
That palm carried no real force
The hit spins you around
I struck lightly, and you still stand
A flash of purple, and you are back
Do not blame me for not measuring my strength
Keep this little noise to yourself
I brush the dust off my hand
One more and you will be out
I already lived around here

lines.zh: 神殿里多了一道紫色的影
lines.en: A purple shadow appears in the temple

lines.zh: 别找了，我不是自然刷出来的
lines.en: Stop searching, I was not spawned naturally
This spot is mine

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，算是登场
lines.en: I yawn, and that is my entrance
Hanging in the air, landing is a bother
Another one has come to consult me

lines.zh: 一百点的师父，够你学的
lines.en: A hundred-point master is plenty to learn from
I glance at the doorway
Come, sit down, do not stand there
Fire reaches my hem, and I put it out

lines.zh: 我飘着也会被你拖下去
lines.en: Even hovering, you drag me down

lines.zh: 水这东西我从来不喜欢
lines.en: Water is something I never liked

lines.zh: 爆炸把宫殿的灰都震下来
lines.en: The blast shakes dust off the palace

lines.zh: 小东西飞过来打在我肩上
lines.en: Something small strikes my shoulder
That spell has some flavor
A hungry master has a worse temper
Lightning lands and feels like scratching
In the void there is not even a temple
